document_version.description: CDP document version at session creation time (lets the agent track when a page has changed without a full re-snapshot).

snapshot_ref_count.description: Number of `@e<N>` refs registered for this session by the initial snapshot.

snapshot_text.description: Indented aria-snapshot text captured during session creation (only populated when `snapshot` was requested and the tab has a loaded page).

snapshot_truncated.description: Whether the initial snapshot was truncated by depth/token caps.

title.description: Tab title at session creation time (only populated when `snapshot` was requested).

url.description: Tab URL at session creation time (only populated when `snapshot` was requested).
